origin.source: Synthesis of the exact N=1, N=2 and N=3 shell-energy reproduction certificates in github.com/morrocwi/readout-problem-navier-stokes, 2026-09-10

claim_boundary: This is a conjunction of three certified fixed-finite-N cases. It is not induction, does not prove a uniform minor construction, and must not be cited as proof of PROP-NSOBS-07.
honest_caveats: Only the ARITHMETIC layer is mechanized: d_N (PROP-NSOBS-01 Definition formula), m_N (the finite shell count, computed by literal enumeration of the {-N,...,N}^3 cube, not asserted), and R_I^min = ceil((d_N-3-m_N)/(m_N-1)) are verified by direct Coq computation to equal (23,49) at N=1, (30,245) at N=2, and (39,681) at N=3 -- exactly the triple this proposal states as a conjunction of PROP-NSOBS-05 (N=1,N=3 shell cases) and PROP-NSOBS-12 (N=2 case). The RANK-ATTAINMENT layer (that the actual finite Fourier-Galerkin NS shell-energy Jacobian attains this arithmetic ceiling at each N) is NOT mechanized here -- it needs the explicit quadratic NS coefficients on the real, divergence-free/reality-constrained basis and an exact-rational rank computation up to a 40x681 Jacobian (N=3), none of which is present in this repo or in the cited .tex locally (same gap already documented for PROP-NSOBS-05 and PROP-NSOBS-12). Tier stays finite_diagnostic, not Th_coqc, because the registered claim as a whole (arithmetic + rank attainment) is not fully mechanized -- only the arithmetic conjunction is. Tier mismatch across this proposal id's 2 duplicate registry entries (finite_diagnostic in ns_energy_observability_extensions.json vs Dr in ns_energy_observability_n2_shell.json) is resolved to finite_diagnostic in both: this is a script/numerically-verified conjunction of finite closed-form cases, not a hand-derivation of new mathematics.
